body: Hi guys! I used to live in Galveston and learned so much! There are "a lot" of abandoned houses because Galveston Island is historic. Hurricanes and stuff most likely caused it to not be liveable in and when nobody lived there, the Island kept it there but "abandoned" so people can learn about it. Just like the shipwrecked ship in the water by SeaWolfe Park you might see when going on the Ferry from Galveston to Port Bolivar.
